The renewal is still under discussion, not finalized. We offered an 8% discount for a two-year term, with quarterly invoicing; Orbitly said 8% was below what they’d discussed and will review with procurement. A call is set for Nov 24. [3]

So, no: we haven’t agreed to the 15% discount they wanted. The 8% offer was approved internally, and anything above 10% needs further approval. [1][3]
